title: [FEATURE] Petition to rename Claude Code to: Flicker Code, or Seizure Code
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

In line with the spirit of the app, and it's best feature, the seizure/flicker mode, this is a petition to rename Claude Code. 

It's been over 7 months and we still haven't got a non-flickering Claude Code. So if the plan is to just leave this "feature" in here forever, instead of open-sourcing CC so someone can fix it, I think it best if we rename the project so that peoples expectations of the UX are adjusted.

### Proposed Solution

%s/Claude Code/Flicker Code/g


### Alternative Solutions

%s/Claude Code/Seizure Code/g


### Priority

Critical - Blocking my work

### Feature Category

Performance and speed

### Use Case Example

Example scenario:
1. I'm working in Flicker Code
2. It starts flickering
3. I don't get mad about flickering because I see that flickering is a feature because the app is called Flicker Code

### Additional Context

_No response_
